scares.description: Francine gets attacked from behind after discovering a body part on the ground.
Scott puts his hand on Chris’s shoulder.
One of the mutant cannibals drops a body beside where some of the group are hiding.
Chris sets off a trap as the group wander through the woods.
The mutants knock on the door of the tree hut.
An axe lands in Carly’s face.
One of the mutants jump down behind Jessie.
Jessie dreams of one of the mutants attacking her with an axe.
An axe is flung at Chris.
The police officer gets shot at by one of the mutants.
A fire suddenly erupts in the house.
Chris gets grabbed from behind while freeing Jessie.
